title: 万に一つもなかったこと

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While Rice Shower trains for the upcoming Takarazuka Kinen, she is recognized by people in the street, and hears their support firsthand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thanks to her fanbase, she manages to win the fan popularity poll and is invited to the Takaruzuka Kinen's opening ceremony at the Hanshin Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We attend a rehearsal for the event, where an accident at the racecourse results in me getting injured.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As the cause of the accident remains unclear, it is decided that the Takarazuka Kinen must be canceled to avoid another incident.
